arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Kedem stated that a prejudice inquiry identifies judgments to reopen.
Justice Sotomayor asked what a defense attorney generally does first when a client wants to appeal.
Justice Ginsburg noted the plea agreement gave fewer years than the law allowed.
Mr. Ali cited a unanimous Court holding that disregarding an appeal instruction is ineffective assistance.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the scope of appeal waivers in guilty pleas. It determines whether defendants can challenge counsel's performance after pleading guilty. The outcome affects the finality of criminal judgments. It impacts the balance between plea deal stability and constitutional rights.
